purpose: A bounded first-168-hour review chain for making an ordinary public route, its human fallback and its withdrawal decision legible before any pilot request.

external_anchor_only.reason: The mapped station remains about 2.31 km from the centroid of the provisional PROV-KEY-003 rough box, so these candidates remain visual screening evidence rather than in-bound formal geometry.

horizons.objective: freeze the digital layer and expose the ordinary route
horizons.owner_role: design and data stewardship role (proposed, not a confirmed institution)
acceptance_checks: no account or model is required for ordinary access
fallback owner is named as a proposed role
all local performance fields remain unknown or null
stop_conditions: a digital layer is required for basic access
the proposed receiver cannot be named

horizons.objective: bind the two in-bound spatial interfaces to eight formal geometry objects and keep Dazhongsi as a withheld external anchor
horizons.owner_role: transport, accessibility and community review roles (proposed)
outputs: dated route and curb inventory request
acceptance_checks: all eight formal refs resolve to the declared GeoJSON features
all four Dazhongsi candidates remain absent from formal roads and public-space layers
each node has a non-AI equivalent
each handoff has a receiving role and a refusal path
stop_conditions: geometry, route ownership or access responsibility is unresolved
a node has no human fallback
consent or data minimization is unresolved

horizons.objective: rehearse the service states without claiming field performance
horizons.owner_role: independent safety, accessibility, privacy and equity review roles (proposed)
acceptance_checks: BASE, BOOST, BLACKOUT and BEQUEST remain distinct
a failed check freezes or returns to public transport/human service
the runner proves only contract completeness
stop_conditions: a negative case is treated as success
a synthetic value is described as an observed outcome

horizons.objective: independently review, publish the boundary and decide whether to remain on hold
horizons.owner_role: maintainer and professional review roles (external to this package)
outputs: HOLD, repair or future field-evidence request
acceptance_checks: the exact package tree is recorded
unknowns are not converted into scores
the default decision is HOLD without dated field evidence
stop_conditions: reviewer cannot reproduce the evidence path
a required professional gate is missing
the package claims an operating result

decision.forbidden_shortcut: No 168-hour tabletop or package runner authorizes a route, operator, capacity, permit or public performance claim.

boundary: This is a design and review schedule, not an executed operating timetable. Authorization, field observations and performance remain zero or unknown until independently supplied and verified.
